description.value: Champions Guild Automation: Firepower: your cannon's damage rolls and Protector's temp HP get +1d8 (module). Detonate: when your cannon takes damage and you're within 60 ft, the module offers your Reaction to detonate it - creatures within 20 ft make a DEX save (your spell DC), 3d10 Force, half on a success, and the cannon is destroyed.

automation.notes: Champions Guild Automation: Firepower +1d8 and the Detonate Reaction by the module (the cannon actor has the Detonate save).
